name: ielts-form-completion
title: Form Completion Trainer
desc: Hear Part 1 style calls about bookings and registrations, and fill in names, numbers, dates and prices. Every call is generated, so you never run out.

name: ielts-spelling-names
title: Spelled Names and Codes
desc: Hear names, postcodes, reference codes and email addresses spelled letter by letter, and type them exactly.

name: ielts-numbers-dates
title: Numbers, Dates and Times
desc: Hear phone numbers, prices, dates, times and years, including the tricky ones such as 15 and 50 and double six.

name: ielts-listening-part2
title: Part 2 Talks
desc: Listen to talks about everyday places and events, such as a museum tour or a sports club, and answer Part 2 style questions.

name: ielts-listening-part3
title: Part 3 Discussions
desc: Listen to students and tutors discussing assignments, and answer multiple-choice and matching questions.

name: ielts-listening-part4
title: Part 4 Lectures
desc: Listen to short academic lectures and complete the notes with one word only, as in Part 4.

name: ielts-map-labelling
title: Map and Plan Labelling
desc: Follow spoken directions round a generated map or floor plan, and label each place with its letter.

name: ielts-distractor-trainer
title: Distractor Trainer
desc: Speakers change their minds and correct each other. Learn to catch the final answer, not the first one you hear.

name: ielts-word-limit
title: Word Limit Rules
desc: Practise the instructions such as NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER, and check whether an answer breaks them.

name: ielts-listening-matching
title: Listening Matching
desc: Match people, places or options to what speakers say about them, as in Parts 2 and 3.

name: ielts-dictation
title: Dictation Trainer
desc: Hear a sentence, type it, and see word by word what you missed.

name: ielts-voices-trainer
title: Different Voices Trainer
desc: Hear the same sentences in every English voice on your computer, at different speeds, as IELTS uses a range of accents.

name: ielts-signpost-listening
title: Lecture Signposts
desc: Learn the phrases lecturers use to move between points, so you always know where the next answer is.

name: ielts-answer-prediction
title: Answer Prediction
desc: Before you listen, predict what kind of word fits each gap: a number, a plural noun, a name or an adjective.

name: ielts-listening-test
title: Listening Test Simulator
desc: A full Listening practice test: four parts and 40 questions, heard once, with 2 minutes to check at the end, as on computer.

name: ielts-listening-vocab
title: Listening Topic Words
desc: Hear and spell the words that come up again and again in IELTS Listening: accommodation, transport, health, study and more.

name: ielts-spelling-pitfalls
title: Spelling Pitfalls
desc: Hear and type the words test takers misspell most, such as accommodation, environment and necessary. A wrong spelling is a wrong answer.

name: ielts-sentence-completion
title: Sentence Completion Listening
desc: Hear a short extract and complete a sentence about it with the right words from what you heard.

name: ielts-speed-listening
title: Speed Listening
desc: Hear the same line slow, normal and fast, and train your ear for natural speech.

name: ielts-listening-paraphrase
title: Paraphrase Spotting
desc: IELTS rarely repeats the words in the question. Hear a sentence and choose the option that says the same thing differently.

name: ielts-tfng
title: True, False or Not Given
desc: Decide whether statements agree with a text, contradict it, or are not mentioned, with the reason for every answer.

name: ielts-ynng
title: Yes, No or Not Given
desc: Decide whether statements match the writer's views or claims, a question type about opinions rather than facts.

name: ielts-matching-headings
title: Matching Headings
desc: Choose the heading that sums up each paragraph, and learn to ignore headings that only match one detail.

name: ielts-matching-information
title: Matching Information
desc: Find which paragraph contains a given piece of information, such as an example, a comparison or a reason.

name: ielts-matching-features
title: Matching Features
desc: Match statements to the researchers, places or dates they belong to, in passages that mention several of each.

name: ielts-sentence-endings
title: Matching Sentence Endings
desc: Complete each sentence with the ending that matches the passage, where several endings are grammatical but only one is true.

name: ielts-summary-completion
title: Summary Completion
desc: Complete summaries of a passage, from a box of words or with words from the text.

name: ielts-short-answers
title: Short-Answer Questions
desc: Answer questions with no more than three words from the passage, spelled exactly as in the text.

name: ielts-diagram-completion
title: Flow-Chart and Diagram Completion
desc: Read descriptions of processes and complete the flow-chart or the labels of a diagram.

name: ielts-academic-reading
title: Academic Reading Practice
desc: Long academic passages with a mix of question types, timed at 20 minutes each, as in the Academic test.

name: ielts-gt-everyday-texts
title: Everyday Texts (General Training)
desc: Notices, adverts, timetables and leaflets with General Training Section 1 style questions.

name: ielts-gt-workplace-texts
title: Workplace Texts (General Training)
desc: Job adverts, staff handbooks and training notices with General Training Section 2 style questions.

name: ielts-skimming
title: Skimming Trainer
desc: Read a paragraph against the clock and pick its main idea, to build the speed IELTS Reading needs.

name: ielts-scanning
title: Scanning Trainer
desc: Find names, dates and numbers in a passage as fast as you can. Questions are made from the passages, so there are over a hundred.

name: ielts-synonym-spotting
title: Synonym Spotting
desc: Match the words in questions to the different words the passage uses for the same idea.

name: ielts-reading-speed
title: Reading Speed Trainer
desc: Measure your reading speed with IELTS-style passages, check understanding, and watch your speed grow.

name: ielts-reading-test
title: Reading Test Simulator
desc: A full Reading practice test: three sections and 40 questions in 60 minutes, in Academic or General Training form.

name: ielts-reference-words
title: Reference Words
desc: Work out what this, it, they and such refer to, a skill behind many wrong answers in Reading.

name: ielts-reading-mcq
title: Multiple-Choice Reading
desc: Multiple-choice questions on passages, including choose TWO, where every wrong option is wrong for a reason.

name: ielts-reading-strategies
title: Reading Strategy Guide
desc: A plan for every Reading question type: what to read first, the usual traps, and a short practice set.

name: ielts-line-graphs
title: Task 1 Line Graphs
desc: Generated line graphs to describe: pick the key features, then write a 150-word report in 20 minutes.

name: ielts-bar-charts
title: Task 1 Bar Charts
desc: Generated bar charts to describe and compare, with key-feature questions and a timed writing space.

name: ielts-pie-charts
title: Task 1 Pie Charts
desc: Generated pie charts with proportions to describe, compare and group, with timed writing.

name: ielts-tables
title: Task 1 Tables
desc: Generated tables of figures: choose what to report, group the data, and write the report.

name: ielts-process-diagrams
title: Task 1 Process Diagrams
desc: Describe processes such as recycling glass or making tea, with sequencing language and the passive voice.

name: ielts-maps-writing
title: Task 1 Maps
desc: Describe how a place changed between two maps, with the language of location and development.

name: ielts-trend-language
title: Language of Change
desc: Rose sharply, levelled off, fluctuated: choose the right verb and adverb for generated changes in data.

name: ielts-approximation
title: Proportions and Approximation
desc: Turn figures into accurate phrases: just over a third, roughly half, nearly three quarters, a fifth.

name: ielts-overview-trainer
title: Task 1 Overview Trainer
desc: Choose the best overview for a generated chart. The overview is what examiners look for first.

name: ielts-gt-letters
title: Task 1 Letters (General Training)
desc: Write formal, semi-formal and informal letters in 20 minutes, covering all three bullet points.

name: ielts-letter-tone
title: Letter Tone Trainer
desc: Choose the right opening, closing and phrasing for formal, semi-formal and informal letters.

name: ielts-task2-writer
title: Task 2 Essay Writer
desc: Write a Task 2 essay of at least 250 words in 40 minutes, with original prompts of every type.

name: ielts-essay-types
title: Essay Type Spotter
desc: Decide whether a prompt asks for an opinion, a discussion, problems and solutions, or advantages and disadvantages.

name: ielts-essay-planner
title: Task 2 Planner
desc: Plan an essay in five minutes with the right structure for its type, then write from your plan.

name: ielts-introductions
title: Introduction Trainer
desc: Choose and write introductions that paraphrase the prompt and give a clear position.

name: ielts-paragraph-builder
title: Body Paragraph Builder
desc: Put topic sentences, explanations and examples in order to build well-organised paragraphs.

name: ielts-cohesion
title: Cohesion Trainer
desc: Linking words and reference words that join ideas without overusing however and moreover.

name: ielts-writing-self-check
title: Writing Self-Check
desc: Check your essay against the four things examiners judge, with plain-language questions for each.

name: ielts-writing-errors
title: Common Writing Errors
desc: Find and fix the mistakes that cost marks most often: agreement, articles, tenses and word choice.

name: ielts-complex-sentences
title: Complex Sentence Builder
desc: Join simple sentences with relative clauses, conditionals and participles, for a wider range of structures.

name: ielts-speaking-part1
title: Speaking Part 1 Practice
desc: Answer everyday questions about home, work, study and interests, read aloud and recorded, as in Part 1.

name: ielts-cue-cards
title: Part 2 Cue Cards
desc: Prepare for one minute with notes, then speak for up to two minutes on a cue card, recorded.

name: ielts-speaking-part3
title: Speaking Part 3 Discussion
desc: Answer deeper questions linked to the Part 2 topics, giving reasons, examples and comparisons.

name: ielts-speaking-test
title: Speaking Test Simulator
desc: A full practice Speaking test: Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3 in order, with the questions read aloud and your answers recorded.

name: ielts-fluency-builder
title: Fluency Builder
desc: Speak on a topic without stopping for one or two minutes, record it, and track how long you keep going.

name: ielts-minimal-pairs
title: Minimal Pairs Trainer
desc: Hear one of two close words, such as ship and sheep, and pick which one, to sharpen the sounds you say.

name: ielts-word-stress
title: Word Stress Trainer
desc: Choose the stressed syllable of common words, and learn the patterns that predict stress.

name: ielts-sentence-stress
title: Sentence Stress Trainer
desc: Hear which word is stressed and what it adds to the meaning, then say sentences with natural stress.

name: ielts-connected-speech
title: Connected Speech Trainer
desc: Understand linking and reduced forms, such as gonna and wanna, in natural spoken English.

name: ielts-speaking-phrases
title: Speaking Phrase Bank
desc: Phrases to give opinions, gain time, compare, speculate and describe, with practice for each.

name: ielts-natural-expressions
title: Natural Expressions
desc: Common idiomatic expressions, when they sound natural and when they do not, so you use them well.

name: ielts-extend-answers
title: Extending Your Answers
desc: Compare short and developed answers, and learn to add a reason, an example or a contrast every time.

name: ielts-part2-notes
title: Part 2 Note Planner
desc: Use the one minute of preparation well: plan keywords for each point on the card, then speak from your notes.

name: ielts-speaking-self-check
title: Speaking Self-Check
desc: Listen back to your recordings and check them against the four things examiners judge.

name: ielts-speculating
title: Speculating and Comparing
desc: The language Part 3 needs: talking about the future, comparing past and present, and giving balanced views.

name: ielts-speaking-journal
title: Speaking Journal
desc: A daily one-minute recording diary with prompts, to make speaking English a habit.

name: ielts-shadowing
title: Shadowing Coach
desc: Speak along with a voice, line by line, to build rhythm and natural pronunciation.

name: ielts-tense-matching
title: Answer in the Right Tense
desc: Questions come in the past, present, future and hypothetical. Choose answers whose tense matches the question.

name: ielts-idea-bank
title: Idea Bank
desc: Arguments and examples for the topics that come up in Speaking Part 3 and Writing Task 2, for and against.

name: ielts-paraphrase-speaking
title: Say It Another Way
desc: Forgot a word? Learn to describe it instead, and practise paraphrasing so you never stop mid-sentence.

name: ielts-academic-vocab
title: Academic Word Trainer
desc: Spaced-repetition cards for the academic words that appear across Reading, Listening and Writing.

name: ielts-topic-vocab
title: Topic Vocabulary
desc: Words for the topics IELTS returns to: environment, education, health, technology, work, cities and more.

name: ielts-collocations
title: Collocation Trainer
desc: Learn which words go together, such as make a decision and heavy traffic, with quick quizzes.

name: ielts-word-forms
title: Word Form Trainer
desc: Choose the right form of a word for the sentence: noun, verb, adjective or adverb.

name: ielts-grammar-drill
title: Grammar Drill
desc: Articles, tenses, agreement, prepositions and more, with the rule behind every answer.

name: ielts-punctuation
title: Punctuation Trainer
desc: Commas, semicolons, apostrophes and run-on sentences, with the rule behind each answer.

name: ielts-british-american
title: British and American English
desc: Spellings and words that differ, such as colour and color or flat and apartment. Both are accepted if you stay consistent.

name: ielts-band-calculator
title: Band Score Calculator
desc: Turn Listening and Reading raw scores into approximate bands, and work out your overall band with the official rounding rule.

name: ielts-study-planner
title: IELTS Study Planner
desc: Turn your test date, hours and weakest skills into a week-by-week plan you can tick off.

name: ielts-mock-test
title: IELTS Mock Test
desc: A full practice test in test order: Listening, Reading, Writing, then Speaking, timed.

name: ielts-error-log
title: IELTS Error Log
desc: Every question you got wrong in any app of the suite, to sort, retry and annotate.

name: ielts-score-tracker
title: IELTS Score Tracker
desc: Log practice bands for the four skills and see your overall band and the trend towards your target.

name: ielts-test-day
title: IELTS Test Day Planner
desc: A countdown and checklist for the week before, the day itself and the Speaking test.

name: ielts-daily-mix
title: IELTS Daily Mix
desc: Fifteen minutes a day across listening, reading, writing and vocabulary, with a streak.

name: ielts-weak-area-finder
title: IELTS Weak Area Finder
desc: A short diagnostic across the four skills, combined with your results in other apps, to show what to study next.

name: ielts-requirements
title: Score Requirements Tracker
desc: Record the overall and per-skill bands your universities or visa need, and see which ones your scores meet.

name: ielts-study-hours
title: Study Hours Tracker
desc: See the minutes you practised in every app of the suite, by day and skill, against a weekly goal.

name: ielts-glossary
title: IELTS Terms Glossary
desc: Plain explanations of the terms in IELTS guides, from Academic and General Training to One Skill Retake.

name: ielts-dashboard
title: IELTS Dashboard
desc: One page that brings together your study time, accuracy, bands, streaks and weak areas from every app.

name: ielts-suite-home
title: IELTS Suite Home
desc: A home screen for the whole suite: find any of the 100 apps by skill and see what to practise today.
